notes.title: Guess the New Characters!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924820/ea27b18d861d58fa771e22232605516f6faa5c6d.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, Masters![/b]

The time has come for a contest within the mystical realms of League of Masters. We invite you to delve into the lore and test your wits by matching the portraits (A-F) of our forthcoming characters to their descriptions (1-6).

To partake in the challenge, write your best guesses in the comments, [b]for example: A-3, B-5, C-1, D-6, E-2, F-2[/b]. The contest shall be concluded on the eve of [b]February the 11th[/b].

Players with the most accurate answers shall be bestowed with treasures from our realm:

[b]💎1,000 Diamonds + 3 Mystery Boxes[/b]

[b]Character No. 1:[/b]

[i]From the vast expanses of the Great Steppe, he journeyed far, finding his new home in the bustling port of Khatrakar, nestled within the realm of Kartel. Through toil, courage, and a mind as keen as the edge of a finely crafted blade, he ascended to the esteemed position of chief over the port.[/i]

[b]Character No. 2:[/b]

[i]One of the powerful leaders within the Cartel, he rules the Free Bravi Syndicate, master of many bands of mercenaries and stealthy assassins. His eyes gleam with the cunning of a thousand battles, and his voice commands the loyalty of his fearless followers. He has sent his Bravi to subdue the magical lands of Atlantis, their blades whispering death in the night.[/i]

[b]Character No. 3:[/b]

[i]Sister to High Priestess and previous queen Xantia, and the aunt to Queen Amaya. In the days when they were but glistening pearls, the caretakers of their sacred nest lost track of who emerged first into the world. While Xantia had once become the Queen, It remains unknown whether it was Xantia or her sister destined for the royal title.[/i]

[b]Character No. 4:[/b]

[i]A disciple of the revered Selim the Wisest, she rose to fame for valiantly defending jinn lamps in times of peril. This protector embodies the virtues of bravery, forthrightness, and exceptional talent, traits that are the hallmark of all those trained under the sage Selim's tutelage.[/i]

[b]Character No. 5:[/b]

[i]Father of Thane Darin and the dark shadow looming over the dwarven lands, is the Thane of the Icepick Clan. His heart, long consumed by the ambition to don the crown, harbors dreams of kingship.[/i]

[b]Character No. 6:[/b]

[i]An architect by trade, he gained renown for creating a marvelous jinn encampment for the ages. With an artistry that transcended mere function, he crafted an architectural marvel, an ensemble of such breathtaking beauty that this once transient settlement was destined to become the enduring capital of Treasure Desert.[/i]

May your wisdom and intuition guide your choices!

notes.title: Christmas Event in League of Masters: Auto Chess
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924820/b5f05eae55e8ef0b46127c9a337b078aa2811681.png[/img]
Get ready to collect New Year Tree Toys until the 27th of December to get lots of great discounts and cashback during the holiday season.

In this news we would like to tell you more about how the New Year Tree Toys work.

There will be 4 types of toys in the game: Snakes, Lions, Badgers and Ice Spirits. You can get them in the Arena.
From the 4 toys, you choose 1 of them to level up. When you level it up, you will get more toys of this type.
The more upgraded the toy is - the bigger the discounts and cashback.
However, to level up a toy you need to collect a certain number of toy sets. With the leveling of the toy, the amount of its drop also increases.
Therefore, for profitable upgrading you can 🎁 exchange toys with other players. Offer them the toy that you have in abundance and receive in return other toys that you do not have enough. You can arrange to exchange toys in this channel ⁠shard-exchange

In addition to shop and bank bonuses, you can also earn gift cards in the contest for the most upgraded New Year Tree Toy. 

1st place - x10 gift cards
2nd place - x6 gift cards
3rd place - x3 gift cards 

Gift cards will be evenly distributed among the same place contenders, if there are any.

Come to the Event to get a boost of Christmas spirit! Gift each other with toys and get great discounts!  🎄 Merry Christmas and Happy New Year to everyone!🎄

notes.title: Black Friday in League of Masters and More!
notes.content:
Hi! In honor of Black Freya Day (a holiday we just made up) and Black Friday, here’s what we’ve added:

- New offers are now available in the Bank.
- Players can bless themselves and double their rating change in the battle start window.
- Comics have been translated into new languages.
- Subscription bonuses now apply to Arena battles.
- The tutorial has been expanded.
- Other technical updates and bug fixes.

And the biggest news—Subscriptions are now in effect for Arena drops!

The Sphere of Prosperity and the Horn of Abundance can now be earned in PvP if you have King Arthur's Royal Privileges ability.

You can read more details on our social media, but for now, jump into the game—there’s plenty more exciting stuff ahead!

notes.title: STEAM RELEASE IS HERE + LIMITED LAUNCH GIFT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924820/7b28eb5f2eef913fcabe734c5972483eff2af54c.png[/img]
The long-awaited moment has arrived — League of Masters is now waiting for you on the Steam platform! 🔥 We’ve put in a lot of effort and passion to make it exciting and engaging.

League of Masters is a cross-platform game, so you can enjoy the freedom to switch between your computer and your smartphone, playing wherever and whenever it’s convenient for you!

Yes, it’s a true challenge! But that’s what makes the game interesting and dynamic, allowing you to sharpen your skills and level up your mastery. In League of Masters, victory requires strategy, perseverance, and skill — and every win will feel truly deserved.

Download, play, and share your experiences! The first 10,000 players to log in will receive our Limited and Exclusive Launch Gift for a great start 🎁

Your feedback is incredibly important to us. Support us with likes, reviews, and recommendations — it inspires us to keep moving forward!

Thank you for your support, and we’ll see you in the game! 🎉

notes.title: League Of Masters | Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Hello to all the masters out there! We're kicking off a series of stories about our game features, gameplay mechanics, and our social media presence to help build a community around our game!

So let's get started! What is [b]League Of Masters[/b]? It's a multiplayer auto-chess strategy game set in a vibrant fantasy world.

[b]League of Masters[/b] takes a unique approach to the autobattler genre. Instead of solely focusing on unit compositions, players can harness the power of 12 unique commanders. Each commander possesses extraordinary abilities that can significantly sway the tide of battle. Form an unstoppable army from over 50 diverse fighters, each with distinct classes and synergies that can be exploited in both PvE and PvP battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924820/5b157662e9b0983c3a272575078e7286603fbdf2.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1][list]
[*] RPG-style player progression
[*] Battles based on popular autochess mechanics
[*] Emphasis on strengthening commanders rather than units
[*] PvP Ranking System
[*] Numerous gaming features for socializing
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Battle Mechanics[/b][/h1][list]
[*] 12 unique commanders with their own set of abilities
[*] Dynamic battles lasting 15-20 minutes
[*] Players create a squad and do not participate directly in battles during rounds
[*] Identical fighters can be combined to enhance their strength
[*] Sets of related fighters offer additional bonuses
[*] The in-battle fighter shop is competitive
[/list]

Feel free to ask questions, add League of Masters to your wishlist, and stay tuned for updates!
